senses.gloss:
m. (-यः)
1 A Veda, or the Vedas in the aggregate.
2 Received doctrine, traditional and right.
3 Traditional usuage, family or national customs.
4 Advice, instruction in past and present usage.
5 A Tantra.
6 An element of being. a property of substance.
E.
आङ्, म्ना to learn, to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Pious, observing the Vedas and national customs.
E.
आम्नाय and सारिन् who goes.
